name: How much does pool landscaping typically cost in the Las Vegas area?

mainEntity.name: How much does pool landscaping typically cost in the Las Vegas area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of pool landscaping in the Las Vegas area varies significantly based on the project's scope, materials chosen, and complexity of the design. Basic enhancements might start from a few thousand dollars, while comprehensive designs with custom features, high-end materials, and extensive hardscaping can range from $20,000 to over $100,000. Factors like the size of your yard, types of plants, amount of artificial turf, and inclusion of structures like pergolas or outdoor kitchens all influence the final price.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool landscaping costs in Las Vegas vary widely, from a few thousand dollars for basic enhancements to over $100,000 for complex designs with custom features and high-end materials.
